name: TECHNIQUES tab (the section headings, both keyswitch captions, and the Free / Scale-Locked glissando panels — 29 labels live behind a display:none tab-content and no resting state shows any of them)
the Free glissando toggle switched ON (ui.onCaps, the other face of a caption whose resting face is ui.offCaps; the C++ default is off, so nothing else reveals it)

BOTH Semitones groups revealed (freeInterval and glissandoInterval set to Custom, index 16, which is what un-hides #freeCustomSemitonesGroup and #glissandoCustomSemitonesGroup). Driven through the PLUGIN'S OWN combo states, not the DOM: setChoiceIndex fires the valueChangedEvent listener the page itself registered, so this is the state the plugin can actually produce.
the Degrees caption revealed (glissandoScale set to Custom, index 3, which is what un-hides #customDegreeToggles). Same mechanism and same reason as above.

TUNING tab (the interval list header with its {n} token substituted, the tonic caption, the five visualization buttons, the library heading, A4 REF, Stretch, the five file buttons and the scale generator)
the scale generator expanded (Generate Scale's three type options, the EDO form's Divisions and Period captions and the Generate button all sit inside a collapsed .generator-content)

the generator switched to Harmonic Series (label.genStart and label.genEnd exist only in that form — handleGeneratorTypeChange REBUILDS #generator-inputs, so no single state can show all three forms at once)
the generator switched to Rank-2 Temperament (label.genGenerator and label.genCount, the last two captions of the third form)

the generator switched BACK to EDO (handleGeneratorTypeChange REBUILDS #generator-inputs, so the Divisions and Period captions the resting markup carries are DESTROYED by the two states above and only exist again once the form is rebuilt — without this they report as never measured while being the form the plugin opens on)
the ROTATION visualization (label.mode is the rotation table's first column header, written into an `html +=` accumulation and keyed afterwards — the one view no resting state renders)

the TRUE KEYS visualization (label.tkHint is the empty-state line inside #truekeys-view, which is display:none in every other mode — as of v2.4.0, because .truekeys-view no longer overrides .viz-view's display and paint itself beside the pitch circle in all five modes)
EFFECTS tab (the four section titles, the four bypass faces and all sixteen knob captions, every one of them written by setLabel from js/app.js rather than authored in the markup)
the Chorus section BYPASSED (ui.off, the other face of the four bypass buttons — their resting face is ui.on)

settings popover OPEN (label.language, label.hoverHelp and the ui.off face of the switch are all inside a [hidden] panel, so no resting state measures them). LAST but one on purpose: the popover's own dismiss handler closes it on a mousedown anywhere else, so opening it earlier would leave it shut by the time the switch below is clicked.

hover help ON (the ui.on face of the settings switch, which no resting state shows — the C++ default is off). A real click on the real control, inside the popover the previous state opened, so the dismiss handler leaves the panel up.
